simple.meaning: צַדִּיק (tsaddîyq) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “just.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 206 times across Genesis, Exodus, Deuteronomy, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, and 8 more, beginning at Genesis 6:9. Its contexts include righteousness, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צַדִּיק (H6662).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: צַדִּיק (tsaddîyq) / H6662 is traced through Genesis 6:9, Genesis 7:1, Genesis 18:23, Genesis 18:24 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H6662. tsaddiq צַדִּיק 206 adjective just, righteous ; — absolute ׳צ Gen 6:9 +; plural צַדִּיקִים Exod 23:8 +, etc.; — 1 just, righteous , in government: a. of Davidic king 2Sam 23:3 ; צֶמַהּ Jer 23:5 ; Zech 9:9 (|| victorious ). b. of judges , Ezek 23:45 ; Prov 29:2 (see Toy; Kau questions this meaning in all these). c. of law , צ ׳מִשְׁמָּטִים Deut 4:8 . d. of God Deut 32:4 ; Psa 119:137 ; 129:4 ; Job 34:17 , opposed to Pharaoh Exod 9:27 (J); in discrimination Jer 12:1 ; Zeph 3:5 ; Psa 7:10 ; 7:12 ; 11:7 ; condemnation 2Chr 12:6 ; Dan 9:14 ; Lam 1:18 ; Ezra 9:15 ; Neh 9:33 ; redemption Isa 45:21 ; Psa 116:5 ; keeping promises Neh 9:8 ; in all his ways Psa 145:17 . 2 just in one's cause, right: Exod 23:7-8 , (E) Deut 16:19 ; 25:1 ; 1Kin 8:32 2Chr 6:23 ; Isa 5:23 ; 29:21 ; Job 32:1 ; 36:7 ; Prov 17:15 , 26 ; 18:5 , 17 ; 24:24 ; Amos 2:6 ; 5:12 ; Hab 1:4 , 13 ; right in law, not under penalty 2Sam 4:11 ; 1Kin 2:32 ; innocent of specific offence 2Kin 10:9 ; with מְן compare 1Sam 24:18 . 3 just, righteous , in conduct and character: a. towards God Gen 7:1 ; 18:23-24 , (twice in verse); 18:25 (twice in verse); 18:26 , 28 (J) 20:4 (E), Hab 2:4 ; Mal 3:18 . b. in General, ethically: Psalm 5:13; Psa 7:10 ; 11:3 ; 11:5 21t. Psalms (+below), Prov 2:20 ; 3:33 ; 4:18 ; 9:9 56t. Proverbs; Eccl 3:17 7 t. Ecclesiastes; Isa 3:10 ; 57:1 (twice in verse); Jer 20:12 ; Lam 4:13 ; Ezek 3:20-21 , (twice in verse) + 12 t. Ezekiel; Hosea 14:10; || תמים Gen 6:9 (P) Job 12:4 ; || נָקִי 17:9 ; 22:19 ; 27:17 ; Psa 94:21 ; || לֵב יִשְׁרֵי 32:11 ; Psalm 64:11; 97:11 . 4 righteous, as justified and vindicated by ׳י , especially servant of ׳י Isa 53:11 , so his people, usually plural 60:21 ; Psa 33:1 8 t. Psalms (see also above); צ ׳אָהֳלֵי 118:15 tents of the righteous ; צ ׳גּוֺרַל 125:3 ; צ ׳עֲדִת 1:5 ; צ ׳דֶּרֶךְ 1:6 ; singular collective 34:20 , 22 ; Psalm 75:11; Isa 24:16 ; 26:7 (twice in verse); צַדִּיק גּוֺי 26:2 (|| אֱמֻנִים שֹׁמֵר ). 5 right, correct , Isa 41:26 (compare אֱמֶת 43:9 ); lawful צ ׳שְׁבִי 49:24 EV; but read עָרִיץ .
